title: Run a software project's tests
description: Runs the project's static checks and tests. The exit codes are the verdict; the report lists each command.

inputs.name: module
inputs.description: Directory of the module, relative to the run root (default: the root)

title: Call a tool on an MCP server
description: Runs one allow-listed tool of a configured MCP server. The server and its tools are configured outside the project definition.

inputs.name: tool
inputs.description: Tool name; must be allowed for that server

title: Upload an asset to storage
description: Copies a file to the configured asset storage and records its stable URL on the output.

outputs.name: asset
outputs.description: Uploaded copy; its url is the storage location

title: Convert a document
description: Markdown, HTML, Word, OpenDocument, EPUB, reStructuredText, LaTeX or plain text, converted locally.

title: Convert an image
description: Raster image format conversion (first frame of an animation unless the target is gif), converted locally.

inputs.name: file
inputs.description: Image to convert (png, jpg, webp, gif, bmp, tiff)

title: Transcode audio or video
description: Audio, video and animated GIF conversion, converted locally.
